readerFinding: The reader is not the gap. PE fact-sheet-resolver.ts identityFacts reads facets.baseFacts.situsAddress; on the new shape baseFacts is undefined, so situs is absent, no geometry seed is available (no envelope geojson, no situs to geocode), resolveGeometry returns null, the parcel is UnplaceableParcel, and PropertyBriefPanel renders VERDICT_UNRESOLVED ('This property has not resolved a fact sheet yet.'). Zoning/setbacks/land use render 'not verified here' because r1BriefCompose reads root.zoning, root.envelope, root.baseFacts.landUse, all absent on the new shape. Full key table in CP2.
designDecisions: Extract the old CLI's assembly (zoning resolution, envelope, acreage, coverage, provenance) into src/lib/nodeFacetTier1Assemble.ts and its txgio join SELECT/discovery into src/lib/nodeFacetTier1ParcelJoin.ts; both CLIs import them. The conformant CLI never imports the old CLI module: its isDirectRun() guard is true inside the esbuild publish bundle (hauska-factory scripts/build-publish-bake-clis.mjs bundles the conformant CLI as one file) and would run the old bake's main() against DATABASE_URL.

Land use comes from the claim (propertyUseCode, taxYear), not from a cad_property join: the claim is the row itself, so the land-use gate does not apply; provenance.landUseGateBlocked is false and parcelJoin carries the join state.

The txgio join is gate-blocked for effectiveBlockedFips (ledger 'block' verdicts UNION LANDUSE_JOIN_DISABLED_FIPS_SEED), the same instrument the old bake uses, because a CAD prop_id joined into a divergent TxGIO numbering attaches another parcel's zoning and geometry. Blocked counties (48209, 48491 today) bake zoning null, envelope null, acreage from claim landAcres, parcelJoin.state gate-blocked.
Acreage: shoelace on the txgio ring (same derivation); claim landAcres only when no ring, with method 'cad-roll-land-acres' so the two are distinguishable.
Coordinates: the bake writes the ring centroid when it has one; on conflict the sentinel never overwrites a real prior coordinate; updated_at is set (the current CLI leaves it stale).
Owner: the claim carries ownerName; the builder never reads it and assertNoOwnerKey refuses any owner-shaped key before a write (same predicate as the serve strip).
No monotonic guard on the conformant path: a publish run overwrites its own rows by design; the old-shape rows of parcels the run does not bake stay in place (V9).
openBeforeBuild: The conformant bake refuses the whole parcel on a punctuation-only situs (16,104 Bastrop rows in run e1b32af8), so those parcels keep their old-shape rows; refusePayloadAtServe reads facets.base.situsAddress and therefore never refuses an old-shape ', ,' row. Existing publish-lane behaviour, not changed here; named for the planner.
county_facet_coverage scores 48209 and 48491 'pass' (0.8315, 0.8890) while LANDUSE_JOIN_DISABLED_FIPS_SEED still blocks them; the bake follows the union as the old CLI does.
